services.name: Joe Bolognese Music Cruise
services.desc: Joe Bolognese is a well known multi-talented music man based in Buffalo, New York. Duration 1.5 Hours About Joe has been the opening music act for Headliners & Worldwide Hall of Fame Bands & Artists. Get your family, friends or group together for this amazingly entertaining experience. You have probably seen Joe perform at local hot spots such as the Hideaway Grill. Amazing show paired with the most amazing sunset skies along the Upper Niagara River and historic Erie

services.name: Civiletto Sings Sinatra Co-starring April Mazzone
services.desc: Civiletto sings Sinatra Co-starring April Mazzone Duration 2 Hours About Enjoy a wonderful evening cruise on the upper Niagara River and watch the sun set as Jack Civiletto sings Sinatra Co-starring April Mazzone. Jack Civiletto and April Mazzone are a wonderful blend of two exceptional talents…...Jack Civiletto shows off his award winning smooth and stylish vocals …...April Mazzone displays a passionate, heartfelt vocal style. Now they will be on the Queen of Peace!!! Amazing show paired with the most amazing sunset skies along the Upper Niagara River and historic Erie

services.name: FREE History Cruises thanks to New York Power Authority and New York State Canal
services.desc: To celebrate the 200th anniversary of the historic Erie Canal, the New York Power Authority and New York State Canal Corporation through the On The Canals program are proud to offer SELECTED (not all) narrated history cruises aboard the Queen Of Peace FREE of charge. Duration & Ticket availability 1.5 Hours In order to provide an opportunity for the most people, there will be a limit of 4 free tickets per person. Duplicate reservations will be cancelled. Ticket Information Your confirmation email will be your ticket. Please print and bring with you on day of your cruise or be prepared to show via mobile as well. NO ALCOHOL BEVERAGES ARE PERMITTED ON THE FREE HISTORY CRUISES IMPORTANT: no
